scope: post-test exploratory presentation analysis using saved frozen predictions only
acceptance_rule: retain confidence >= threshold; retain all confidence ties together
utility_denominator: all original responses, including abstained cases with utility zero
selective_accuracy_denominator: retained responses only; undefined when no responses retained

bootstrap.shared_resamples: same resampled pairs across every model and threshold; keep all responses and pair multiplicity
bootstrap.conditional_interval_policy: Report retained-accuracy intervals only when support rule passes and every resample has retained responses. Count undefined resamples explicitly.
bootstrap.interpretation: exploratory pointwise intervals, not multiplicity-adjusted; conditional on fitted models and development choices

model_implied_utility: Sum of retained (2*confidence-1) divided by all original responses; valid as expected correctness utility only under calibrated probabilities.
decision_theory_note: With correct +1, wrong -1, abstain 0 and calibrated probabilities, always predict is weakly optimal in expected total utility because confidence is at least 0.5. Higher selective accuracy alone does not establish a total-utility benefit.
threshold_selection: none; do not maximize test utility, tune a threshold, select a new winner, or modify deployment
not_performed: changing existing report or code ZIP
